question: Should the default user-action-only policy fail closed for every opaque Claude CLI Keychain path, accepting that background Auto refresh may pause until the user explicitly clicks Refresh?
rationale: The patch consistently enforces the configured policy, but it intentionally replaces some existing background authentication and repair behavior with a user-visible manual recovery requirement.

options.title: Enforce the stored policy
options.body: Accept the fail-closed background behavior after affected-Mac proof confirms prompt suppression and successful explicit recovery.

options.title: Preserve background attempts
options.body: Prefer a bounded cooldown or another compatibility mechanism, such as the approach in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2163, rather than disabling background subprocess authentication by default.

recommendation.title: Enforce the stored policy
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed background behavior after affected-Mac proof confirms prompt suppression and successful explicit recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant background auth preflight was merged under this ownership trail, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
